summary: Event call sites now share one rule for listener names. The rule comes first, then the first call site that uses it.

steps.title: One rule for event listener names
steps.rationale: The naming rule every event call site will share; read it on its own first
steps.notes: Every event binding turns an event type into a listener name the same way, for example click into onClick. Keeping that rule in one helper, `eventActionName`, stops call sites from drifting apart.

steps.title: JSX events use the shared rule
steps.rationale: The first call site to switch to that rule
